messages:
maya: Kicking off observability QC for the new gpu zone (euc3-gpu1). I ran the basic smoke tests; need a quick review of logs/metrics/traces, dashboards, and alerting rules before we hand off to platform ops.

liam: Thanks — can you paste the smoke checklist here? I'll run through alert rules and rate limits.

maya: Copying the checklist I used: 
- verify Loki ingestion from node-exporter/filebeat -> loki (via promtail)
- confirm Prometheus scrape targets (k8s nodes, kube-state-metrics, gpu-exporter)
- trace sampling: tempo ingestion + service graph sanity
- Grafana dashboards load and show recent 1h traffic
- alertmanager hook test for critical alerts (node down, OOM, GPU memory saturating)

sofia: Quick note: we had NAT egress flaky in this AZ earlier — make sure the loki push endpoint uses the private transit gateway, not default internet. I pushed a temporary fix in the k8s egress policy.

omar: I checked Prom targets: all node exporters up, but gpu-exporter is missing on one k8s node (euc3-gpu1-03). Could be daemonset scheduling.

maya: thx, @omar. Can you run this command on the node to check daemonset?
```
kubectl -n monitoring describe daemonset gpu-exporter | egrep -A3 "Nodes:|Desired Number" 
kubectl get pods -n monitoring -o wide | grep gpu-exporter
```
omar: Ran it — gpu-exporter was Pending due to taint: "gpu.reserve=dedicated:NoSchedule". I patched the daemonset tolerations and it started pulling images. Logs show CUDA lib warnings but exporter is registering.

liam: Moving to alert rules: created a short-term rule to catch GPU memory pressure. Snippet below (we will convert to our rule repo):
```yaml
groups:
  - name: gpu.rules
    rules:
      - alert: GPUHighMemoryUsage
        expr: gpu_memory_utilization_bytes / gpu_memory_total_bytes > 0.9
        for: 5m
        labels:
          severity: critical
        annotations:
          summary: "GPU memory > 90% ({{ $labels.instance }})"
```
liam: Also set an alert to page on Prometheus target down for >3m.

sofia: Dashboards: I pushed a new Grafana playlist and a dashboard UID 'gpu-cluster-overview' (UID: a1b2c3d4). Verify panels for: GPU mem, GPU util, pod OOMs, kube-scheduler pending, and loki ingestion rate.

maya: Verified dashboard loads and panels show data for past 1h. Two panels show sparse traces — seems Tempo sampling rate is low for non-prod. We should increase sampling for the infra services temporarily.

omar: I bumped tempo sampling for the kube-system services to 10% via k8s configmap and restarted collector. Traces now visible. Note: cost impact small for traces but logs retention is the heavy hitter.

liam: On cost: propose default retention for this gpu zone: logs 7d, metrics 30d, traces 14d (sampling 10%). This keeps egress/storage low for early days. Anyone object?

sofia: +1 for retention defaults. Also recommend enabling Loki chunk compaction and setting max_line_size to avoid huge payloads from driver logs.

maya: Action items before handoff: 
1) Confirm gpu-exporter is auto-scheduled via tolerations (omar) 
2) Promote the alert rules to staging repo and run alertmanager hook test (liam) 
3) Confirm Grafana dashboard UID and add to onboarding index (sofia) 
4) Apply retention policies and document expected monthly cost (maya)

deploy-bot: CI:monitoring/gpu-zone-smoke passed (build 347) :white_check_mark:

liam: I ran alertmanager hook test — test alert routed to PagerDuty, slack channel #eng-sre, and to the webhook. All good. I pushed rule PR to infra-monitoring/rules with the GPU rule and target-down rule.

maya: I've recorded the expected incremental cost for logs at 7d (~$420/mo for zone), metrics 30d (~$60/mo), traces 14d (~$90/mo). Details in the onboarding doc (linked).

sofia: Left a few comments on PR for small cleanup. Once addressed, I'm happy to merge and tag for release.

omar: Confirmed daemonset tolerations persisted in kustomize overlay. Node 03 stable and gpu-exporter metrics consistent.

maya: Good. Marking this ready for handoff to platform ops. @liam please take final sign-off, then I'll move the runbook to /ops/handoffs and schedule the knowledge transfer.

liam: Signing off from SRE perspective. Go ahead with the handoff and schedule 30m rundown.

maya: Thanks everyone — will follow up with the handoff doc and the short recording. :rocket:
